applicability: The re-validation of the task entry's changed-intent summary in the dashboard cockpit.
conditions: The cockpit shell provides IntentEntryRevalidation with shown = Operations view and no takeover.
Each trigger costs exactly one summary read.
exclusions: A live push of the count while the same panel stays open.
Any new watcher, projection field or event channel for knowledge writes.
statement: Architect ruling on blocked L47-R1-F2: no new event or projection system; the entry summary re-reads whenever the task detail is opened or re-shown, whenever the reviewer is left back to the entry, and on the reviewer's own refresh.
